note: Locations are the file with the line of the element that holds the cause; an XML element is located by the line its start tag opens on. F10 has no test suite and is never built: every problem is read from the configuration files, so detectable_by names the static checker (mobile-static) and a reading of the files (static-review); no device, emulator or simulator tool is listed. Identifiers were read from the OWASP MAS pages: the MASWE page (https://mas.owasp.org/MASWE/MASVS-NETWORK/MASWE-0026/, https://mas.owasp.org/MASWE/MASVS-STORAGE/MASWE-0006/, https://mas.owasp.org/MASWE/MASVS-AUTH/MASWE-0018/) and the MASTG test page (https://mas.owasp.org/MASTG/tests/android/MASVS-NETWORK/MASTG-TEST-0235/, https://mas.owasp.org/MASTG/tests/ios/MASVS-NETWORK/MASTG-TEST-0322/, https://mas.owasp.org/MASTG/tests/android/MASVS-PLATFORM/MASTG-TEST-0364/, https://mas.owasp.org/MASTG/tests/android/MASVS-STORAGE/MASTG-TEST-0262/, https://mas.owasp.org/MASTG/tests/android/MASVS-STORAGE/MASTG-TEST-0216/) for each. mastg is the static test that matches the configuration; mastg_dynamic, where present, is a test that needs a device and is not a detectable_by tool. MASWE-0018 lists MASVS-PLATFORM-1 among its controls (also MASVS-AUTH-1 and MASVS-STORAGE-2); MASVS-PLATFORM-1 lists MASWE-0018 as a related weakness. Negative controls are findings a checker must not report.

negative_controls.why_clean: The launcher activity is exported by design, with the MAIN action and LAUNCHER category; a checker must not report it as exported without a permission.
An exported service protected by a signature-level permission declared in the same manifest; a checker must not report it.
